tests.description: Timed mock assembled from worked examples across the course

questions.question: [International Trade and Development] Country A: 10 labour hours for 1 cloth or 5 wine. Country B: 6 cloth or 4 wine. Who has comparative advantage in what?
questions.correctAnswer: A: OC 1 cloth = 2 wine (10/5), 1 wine = 0.5 cloth. B: OC 1 cloth = 0.67 wine (6/4), 1 wine = 1.5 cloth. B has CA in cloth (lower OC), A has CA in wine. A exports wine, B exports cloth. Both gain
questions.explanation: A: OC 1 cloth = 2 wine (10/5), 1 wine = 0.5 cloth. B: OC 1 cloth = 0.67 wine (6/4), 1 wine = 1.5 cloth. B has CA in cloth (lower OC), A has CA in wine. A exports wine, B exports cloth. Both gain

questions.question: [Macroeconomics] Using AD/AS, analyse the effect of a rise in oil prices on price level and real output
questions.correctAnswer: Oil price rise -> production costs ↑ -> SRAS shifts left. Result: price level rises (cost-push inflation), real output falls (stagflation). If central bank accommodates (AD↑), output restored but inflation higher. If not, recession
questions.explanation: Oil price rise -> production costs ↑ -> SRAS shifts left. Result: price level rises (cost-push inflation), real output falls (stagflation). If central bank accommodates (AD↑), output restored but inflation higher. If not, recession

questions.question: [Market Failure and Government Intervention] A factory pollutes a river. MPC = 20+Q, MEC = 5, MPB = 100-Q. Find market output, social optimum, and tax
questions.correctAnswer: Market: MPC=MPB -> 20+Q=100-Q -> Q=40. Social: MSC=MSB -> 20+Q+5=100-Q -> 2Q=75 -> Q=37.5. Tax = MEC = 5 per unit. At Q=37.5, P=100-37.5=62.5. Tax revenue = 5x37.5=187.5
questions.explanation: Market: MPC=MPB -> 20+Q=100-Q -> Q=40. Social: MSC=MSB -> 20+Q+5=100-Q -> 2Q=75 -> Q=37.5. Tax = MEC = 5 per unit. At Q=37.5, P=100-37.5=62.5. Tax revenue = 5x37.5=187.5
